title: Registration-Year Fee for Pets, Community Rules & Site Care Statement Note
content:
On the Community Rules & Site Care statement, the registration-year fee of a registered pet is the plan's annual pet registration fee for that pet, stated in dollars and cents, and the fee is posted rounded half up to the cent.

Each registered pet carries its own fee for each calendar registration year. In the pet's first year the fee is dated the registration date; in each later year it is dated January 1.

## Worked example

Hypothetical plan figure of $22.50, chosen for illustration and not a schedule value. A household has had a cat registered since 2024 and registers a dog on 12 May 2026.

| Pet | Registration year | Fee dated | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cat | 2026 | January 1, 2026 | $22.50 |
| Dog | 2026 | 12 May 2026 | $22.50 |
| Cat | 2027 | January 1, 2027 | $22.50 |
| Dog | 2027 | January 1, 2027 | $22.50 |

## Basis questions

**Is the first-year fee smaller for a pet registered late in the year?** No. The fee for a registration year is the plan's annual pet registration fee for that pet, whatever the registration date.

**Does a household with two pets carry one fee or two?** Two: each registered pet carries its own registration-year fee.
